parsed.body:
It is impossible to satisfy all three requirements simultaneously. A comparison‑based sorting algorithm cannot achieve O(n) worst‑case time complexity; the lower bound for comparison sorts is Ω(n log n). Consequently, no stable, in‑place, O(1) extra‑space algorithm exists that meets the O(n) worst‑case time constraint.

Therefore the task cannot be fulfilled under the stated constraints.
